plan.title: docs: accuracy audit, Getting Started, Vision and Changelog intro (5 pages)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Docs-only audit of five root-level Mintlify pages plus three shared screenshot pairs. The finalize lint counts each root .mdx page and the images directory as separate subsystems, but they form one nav-group audit that shares one validation pass and one PR body, as the epic (#5467) scopes one audit issue per nav group.

narratives.Problem: The five first pages a new user reads (introduction, quickstart, concepts, the Flywheel vision and the changelog intro) still make claims the product no longer matches: a test agent on every PR, GitLab issue tracking, wrong Pipeline lanes and metric, a Home stuck count, Deacon health pills, deleted vision files and commands, a wrong merge and UAT model, an old bot login, and screenshots that still show the Panopticon v0.21.0 brand.
narratives.Proposal: Apply the per-page change tables in .pan/drafts/PAN-5499.md, each row carrying a grep anchor, replacement text and code evidence; remove en and em dashes; fix frontmatter; recapture the three stale screenshot pairs with scripts/capture-doc-shot.mjs; run the Mintlify validators; write a PR body with one note per page and a Follow-ups list for the code and prompt bugs found.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Rewriting changelog <Update> release records, including the em dash inside the quoted UI string at changelog.mdx line 611
- Changing vision v1.0 targets, thresholds, definitions, industry anchors or still-open questions
- Editing any page outside the five audited pages, including alt text on other pages that use the recaptured images
- Fixing code or prompt bugs the audit found (roles/flywheel.md bot login and UAT text, roles/review.md test dispatch, scripts/install.sh Node check, #5537); they go to Follow-ups
- Auditing reference/template-conversations.mdx (owned by #5504)
- Adding help sections to concepts.mdx, vision.mdx or changelog.mdx
- Any docs.json, CLAUDE.md, rule, role or changelog.d change
- Editing image pixels by hand

autoDecisions.summary: Audit only the changelog intro (frontmatter, two paragraphs, RELEASE STEP comment), not the <Update> release records.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue title says 'Changelog intro'; release records are dated history written by pan release stable, and rewriting them would change history.

autoDecisions.summary: On introduction and concepts, drop the 'test agent checks every PR' claim and state only what holds whether or not #5537 lands, linking /features/issue-pipeline.
autoDecisions.rationale: #5537 is open and its fix direction is undecided; features/issue-pipeline.mdx already documents current behavior, so the overview pages should not repeat a caveat that may soon change.

autoDecisions.summary: On vision.mdx, correct current-state facts only and keep the operator's targets, thresholds and definitions.
autoDecisions.rationale: The vision page is operator direction; an accuracy audit fixes what the page says the product does today, not what the operator wants v1.0 to be.

autoDecisions.summary: Recapture the hero, board and pipeline screenshot pairs in place, with a keep-old-images fallback when no dashboard is reachable.
autoDecisions.rationale: All three are from 2026-06-04 and show the Panopticon v0.21.0 brand on the landing page and quickstart; scripts/capture-doc-shot.mjs exists, and same-name files fix every page that uses them.

autoDecisions.summary: Retitle concepts, vision and changelog with specific searchable titles and keep short sidebarTitles.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's frontmatter rule asks for specific searchable titles; 'Changelog' and 'Flywheel Vision' are generic, and sidebarTitle keeps the nav labels short.

autoDecisions.summary: Treat GitLab as a code host only on introduction and concepts.
autoDecisions.rationale: src/lib/tracker/gitlab.ts returns notImplemented for every method, and configuration/issue-trackers.mdx already says GitLab issue tracking is not supported.
